environment.description: kind clusters on a GitHub-hosted runner; not a production benchmark
envtest kube-apiserver + etcd on one host; simulated OCM work agent; no real managed clusters
environment.note: activation = lease created until every cluster's ManifestWork carries the grant; ready = until the lease reports Ready after simulated acknowledgement; revocation = lease deleted until no ManifestWork carries it
